name: Terran Shields
desc: Standard shields used aboard Terran vessels. Oftentimes, these shields are built into the starship. When installed, the shields make a ship different from standard Starsector type shields. Terran Shields use hitpoints rather than flux. Second, there are many vanilla weapons that are rendered ineffective against Terran shields, due to the advanced nature of Terran shields. That does not mean that Terran Shields are wholly impervious. There are still many weapons that can do chip or even heavy damage to Terran shields.
short: Federation style shielding. Hitpoints are used instead of flux. Shields can recovery with the proper system installed.
